name: League Table
summary: Ranked adviser / acquirer / investor list with rank change, inline value bars, market share and deal count; highlight your own name.
summary_zh: 财务顾问 / 收购方 / 投资人排名表：名次变化箭头、行内数值条、市场份额与交易数量，可高亮自家机构。
description_zh: 投行 credentials 页的标准 League Table：每行一家机构，按 rank（或按数值重新排名）排列，显示较上期名次变化（▲/▼/–/New）、行内横条表示交易金额并在条尾标注数值，右侧为市场份额和交易数。highlight 指定的机构用强调色标出，即使不在前 N 名也会在虚线下方保留显示；点击 Value / Share / Deals 表头可重新排序（行平滑移动），点击行可交叉筛选。适合 5–20 家机构的排名展示。
best_for: M&A / ECM / DCM adviser league tables
Top acquirers or investors by deal value
Any ranked list where one name must stand out
avoid_when: More than ~20 names (use bar or data-grid)

rank.desc: Rank (computed from value when missing or rerank: true)

value.desc: Ranking value drawn as the inline bar

prior.desc: Prior-period rank for the change arrow (null = New)

highlight.desc: Name(s) drawn in the highlight accent (e.g. your bank)

top.desc: Show the top-N rows; null = all

pinHighlight.desc: Keep highlighted names visible below the top-N cut

rerank.desc: Rank by value instead of the rank field

format.desc: Value format (defaults to the value field format)

shareFormat.desc: Share format (defaults to the field format, else 0.0%)

countFormat.desc: Count format (defaults to the field format, else #,##0)

sortable.desc: Click the value / share / count headers to re-order (third click restores rank order)

showChange.desc: Rank change vs prior rank column

titles.desc: {rank, change, name, value, share, count} header overrides

crossFilter.desc: Click a row to cross-filter other blocks on the name field

interactions: Bars grow with a stagger while values count up
Click a metric header to re-order (FLIP row animation)
Click a row to cross-filter (others dim)
Bars re-scale smoothly when filters change
